high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Indian Express," a news website. The article discusses the recent session of the UN Human Rights Council, focusing on the call for a monitoring mission on human rights in Afghanistan by the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, Michelle Bachelet. However, the council voted on a resolution that was watered down, asking Bachelet to report on the situation at its next session.
